title: Soul Feast #6: Responsible Choice – Creating a Life of Love Through Conscious Decisions
excerpt: In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav explores the profound concept of responsible choice and its transformative power in our personal and spiritual growth.
bodyHtml:
In today’s Soul Feast, Gary Zukav explores the profound concept of responsible choice and its transformative power in our personal and spiritual growth. 

He explains that responsible choice means fully accepting the consequences of our decisions, recognizing that each choice either brings us closer to love or pulls us deeper into fear. 

Gary highlights the importance of acting from love and intention, rather than from the fear-based parts of our personalities.

This Soul Feast introduces the role of emotional awareness in making responsible choices, showing how we can consciously align our actions with love. 

By reflecting on our choices each day, we can learn to craft our lives with intention and create authentic power. 

Gary encourages listeners to use a daily reflection practice to deepen awareness and embrace the journey of love.

What You’ll Discover in This Soul Feast:

  • (00:27): What it means to make a responsible choice and why owning the outcomes of each decision is essential in shaping your reality.
  • (01:49): How every intention influences the consequences of our choices.
  • (3:55): Differentiate between an intention and a goal.
  • (05:50): The connection between emotional awareness and choosing consciously from a place of love.
  • (20:57): A simple reflection exercise for recognizing and learning from your moment to moment choices.
  • (21:49): How to view your life as a canvas where each responsible choice adds meaning and beauty to your personal journey.

Are you making choices in love or fear?  Take this self-assessment today to find out.
